Rules.Description: Can attack target with melee weapon if in range and has weapon
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.HasTarget == true AND input1.DistanceToTarget <= 1.5 AND input1.Equipment.CanMelee == true AND input1.Stamina >= 10

Rules.Description: Can attack target with ranged weapon if has bow
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.HasTarget == true AND input1.DistanceToTarget <= 10.0 AND input1.Equipment.CanRanged == true AND input1.Stamina >= 5

Rules.Description: Can cast spell if has staff and mana
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.HasTarget == true AND input1.Equipment.CanCastSpells == true AND input1.Mana >= 20

Rules.Description: Can use health potion if injured and has potions
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.Inventory.HasHealthPotion == true AND input1.Health < input1.MaxHealth

Rules.Description: Can use mana potion if low on mana and has potions
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.Inventory.HasManaPotion == true AND input1.Mana < input1.MaxMana
input1.Health > 0 AND input1.IsCriticallyInjured == true AND input1.Stamina >= 20

Rules.Description: Can rest if safe and needs recovery
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.IsSafe == true AND input1.IsInCombat == false AND (input1.HealthPercent < 1.0 OR input1.ManaPercent < 1.0 OR input1.StaminaPercent < 1.0)

Rules.Description: Can move toward combat target if target is far
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.HasTarget == true AND input1.DistanceToTarget > 1.5 AND input1.Stamina >= 5

Rules.Description: Can move toward quest goal or destination
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.GoalPosition != null AND input1.DistanceToGoal > 1.0 AND input1.Stamina >= 5

Rules.Description: Can explore dungeon if safe and healthy
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.IsSafe == true AND input1.IsInDungeon == true AND input1.HealthPercent > 0.5 AND input1.Stamina > 20

Rules.Description: Can return to town if low on resources or critically injured
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.IsInTown == false AND (input1.IsCriticallyInjured == true OR input1.Inventory.HasBasicResources == false)

Rules.Description: Can pickup items if nearby (simplified - would check actual item proximity)
Can interact with NPCs in town
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.IsInTown == true AND input1.IsInCombat == false

Rules.Description: Can accept new quest if not already on one
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.HasActiveQuest == false AND input1.IsInTown == true

Rules.Description: Can complete quest objective (simplified - would check actual objective)
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.HasActiveQuest == true AND input1.GoalPosition != null AND input1.DistanceToGoal <= 1.0

Rules.Description: Can block incoming attacks if has shield
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.IsInCombat == true AND input1.Equipment.HasShield == true AND input1.Stamina >= 15

Rules.Description: Can dodge attacks if has stamina
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.IsInCombat == true AND input1.Stamina >= 20

Rules.Description: Can eat food to restore stamina
